source_metadata.current_host: FiniteGasFullCycle.gas_viscosity at pure composition; current alpha1

source_functions.H2O: iapws._iapws._Viscosity(rho=0,T); Eq11 only at zero density

source_metadata.pressure_definition: Pure rho->0 constitutive limit, not pure fluid at total mixture pressure, saturation curve or in-pore effective resistance.
source_metadata.domain_policy: N2/O2 current298.15–1223.15K lies within cited dilute data spans; no uniform uncertainty proof. CO2 admitted100–2000K. Water above1173.15K is explicit high-T dilute extrapolation, even though source describes reasonable extrapolation to2500K.
source_metadata.budget: 24 reported states: reuse6 independent current-host/source values;18 new host/source evaluations. Zero integration, optimizer, root solve or parameter search.
source_metadata.accuracy_policy: Report signed/relative deviations. No invented experimental pass limit; finite samples do not constitute uniform continuous error bounds.
source_metadata.coupling: Changing pure curves requires temperature-dependent Wilke Phi; Darcy uses positive mu and existing common flux/enthalpy, no extra viscous heat.

limitations: These sampled discrepancies are not a continuous maximum-error bound. No empirical tolerance was invented.

N2/O2 and CO2 previously passed source arithmetic/printed-anchor checks; water wheel Eq11 was checked against the official formula and constants, not granted the unrelated IAPWS95 EOS33/33 qualification.
All references are pure zero-density bulk viscosity. No finite-density, mixture, slip, Knudsen or pore-radius qualification follows.
Water1223.15K is beyond1173.15K recommended validity; source describes reasonable dilute extrapolation, not equal uncertainty.

failure_and_repair.error: NotADirectoryError importing iapws155 wheel directly: package __init__ reads VERSION with a filesystem open
failure_and_repair.repair: Unpack the same existing wheel into a temporary runtime directory; do not modify source formula or install/download dependencies. One corrected invocation.

independent_review: p06_inverse read-only: scope/counts/units/zero-density/domain passed; source curves require NumPy complex/broadcast support and same-temperature Wilke Phi.

decision.reason: The shared temperature power cannot reproduce the different published dilute-gas temperature dependences. Sampled deviations reach about42.24% for water and15.46% forCO2; these are not uniform error bounds. All four available correlations provide a coherent cited bulk dilute-gas basis within the existing low-density Wilke assumption, without fitting brick parameters. Replacement is based on source/form applicability and available implementation, not an invented percent pass threshold.
decision.what_improves: Pure bulk constitutive provenance and temperature dependence only.
decision.what_does_not_improve: No pressure-density correction, measured pore permeability, slip/Knudsen correction, accurate mixed-gas collision solution or target material qualification.
decision.affected_coupling: Same reciprocal-log face temperature drives pure curves and Wilke Phi; mixture viscosity enters existing Darcy flux, then species/enthalpy/entropy ledgers. No new storage, state, reaction or viscous heat.
